tools.name: Apple Notes
tools.description: Read and write notes in Apple Notes. List, search, create, update, append and delete notes and folders.

tools.name: Apple Reminders
tools.description: Manage Apple Reminders — list, create, complete, delete and search reminders across all lists.

tools.name: Audio
tools.description: Exposes macOS audio as live MCP resources that push on change: output volume/mute (resource://audio/output), input (mic) volume/mute (resource://audio/input), and the device inventory with each device's live volume/mute + current defaults (resource://audio/devices). Tools: get/set output & input volume + mute (targeting the default device or any specific device by UID), and list / switch the default output & input device.

tools.name: Bash / Shell
tools.description: Run shell commands and scripts on macOS. Capture stdout/stderr, open interactive Terminal windows, and automate system tasks. Also starts long-running processes by handle and exposes each one's live status as a subscribable resource (resource://bash/process/{id}), so a button face can reflect whether a process is running.

tools.name: Google Chrome
tools.description: Control Chrome tabs and windows via JXA. Optionally enable CDP (--remote-debugging-port=9222) for JS execution, page source, and screenshots.

tools.name: Clipboard
tools.description: Read, write, transform, and manage the macOS system clipboard. Supports plain text, HTML, RTF, file paths, and clipboard history.

tools.name: Launcher
tools.description: Open apps, folders, URLs and reveal files in Finder using the macOS open command.

tools.name: Obsidian
tools.description: Read and write notes in your Obsidian vault. Search by content, create and update notes, manage folders, and navigate your vault structure.

tools.name: OpenAI
tools.description: Structured LLM calls, image analysis (GPT-4o vision), and Whisper audio transcription. All tools share a single API key.

tools.name: QuickTime Player
tools.description: Control QuickTime Player via AppleScript. Record audio (microphone → M4A) and screen (full screen → MOV), open media files, and list open documents. On first use macOS will ask permission to control QuickTime — click Allow once.

tools.name: Safari
tools.description: Control Safari tabs and windows via AppleScript. Includes JS execution, page source and text via 'Allow JavaScript from Apple Events' (no extension or debug port needed).

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Capture the screen, frontmost window, a clicked window, or an interactive drag-selected region as a PNG image. Saves to a path (creating folders as needed) or returns base64. Also records the screen to video.

tools.name: VS Code
tools.description: Control VS Code windows — toggle sidebar/terminal/panels, run commands, create terminals, open folders. Requires the 'nicollasr.vscode-streamdeck' extension installed in VS Code.

tools.name: Window Management
tools.description: Move, resize and snap windows across screens. Get frontmost app, list open windows, snap to halves/quarters, and manage multiple displays.
